news.title: SVAGS Technologies Launches Its First Product: SVAGS Smart Car Service Platform
news.excerpt: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES announces the launch of SVAGS, a revolutionary smart car service platform that connects vehicle owners with trusted service centers.

news.title: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES Incorporated in India
